name: basalt-core-demo
description: The demo app this host renders. react, react-native and metro resolve out of the React Native checkout that scripts/bootstrap.sh already set up, so there is nothing here for them. A third-party native module has no such home: storage.tsx imports async-storage, which is declared below and installed into a gitignored e2e/node_modules by scripts/test_all.sh and by CI. Declared rather than installed loose, because React Native's codegen reads an app's dependencies to decide which specs to generate: with nothing declared it finds no libraries and the host is built without the native half. See metro.config.js.
